units.source_text: 名人下白130以后，不知从哪儿传来了悦耳的尺八声，多少缓和了棋盘上的风暴。

en.t: After the Master played White 130, the pleasant sound of a shakuhachi drifted in from somewhere, somewhat easing the storm over the go board.

units.source_text: 名人侧耳倾听，仿佛想起什么似的说：

en.t: The Master turned his ear and listened, then spoke as if something had come back to him:
